question.prompt: Members of the Rockham Soccer League buy socks and T-shirts. Socks cost \(\$4\) per pair and each T-shirt costs \(\$5\) more than a pair of socks. Each member needs one pair of socks and a shirt for home games and another pair of socks and a shirt for away games. If the total cost is \(\$2366,\) how many members are in the League?

solutions.explanation:
First find the clothing cost for one member, since every member needs the same items. A T-shirt costs \(4+5=9\) dollars, so one pair of socks and one shirt cost \(4+9=13\) dollars.

Each member needs one such outfit for home games and another for away games. The cost per member is therefore \(2\cdot13=26\) dollars. Dividing the total cost by this amount gives
\[
\frac{2366}{26}=91.
\]
Thus there are \(\boxed{91}\) members, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Find the cost per member
